description: This source file defines data structures and functions related to loading and parsing gateway configurations from a JSON file. It includes struct definitions for configuration data, a function to load the configuration from a file, and a helper function to parse integers from different types.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: A struct representing the gateway configuration with optional properties for mode, bind address, port, URLs, tokens, and passwords.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A struct representing an endpoint with URL, token, password, and mode.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads gateway configuration from a JSON file located in the user's home directory, parsing nested JSON objects to populate the GatewayConfig struct.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses an Int value from various input types such as Int, Double, or String.
